You are looking at the continent of Africa and saying people who lived in Africa sold other people who also lived in Africa.
Like saying the people who lived within a certain region of the continent, or country sold other people who lived in the same region. (Earthlings sold other Earthlings/Humans sold other humans) Because you live in the same place doesn't make you the same "people" or make the other people living there your own. There were various Kingdoms in Africa over different times. The King or Ruler considered everyone within their kingdom, their subjects or "people" if you will.
